trait.name: Heat Aura
entries: At the end of each of the remorhaz's turns, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the remorhaz takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Fire damage.
